entities.summary: Alexandra Alina Dăscalu is a French female volleyball player who currently plays for Italian club Baronissi, as a right side hitter. She is also a member of the France women's national volleyball team. Her father, Pompiliu, is a retired volleyballer and current coach in France. Dăscalu's younger sister, Silvana, is also a volleyball player. Alexandra Dascalu was a athletes & competitors from Palma (b. 1991-04-17, Palma).
